summary: This Form 6-K filed by Castor Maritime Inc. announces the scheduling of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on September 11, 2026, with a record date of July 17, 2026. The filing includes the proxy materials and proxy card. No special situation, such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event, is present. The filing is a routine procedural notification regarding the annual shareholder meeting. As a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16, this corresponds to a US annual meeting notice.
